lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Si2Co8 (reduced formula MgSiCo4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with 12 geometric neighbors (2 Co, 4 Mg, 6 Si) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg and Si each have 10 neighbors (4 Co and 6 Co, respectively). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Co 12-vertex polyhedra and among Mg and Si 10-vertex polyhedra.
